title: When the Ember Wakes Revisited
author: X. M. Voss
blurb: Yara Ishikawa, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
